property_summary: For any callee address whose fallback/revert behaviour may fail, the reference C always propagates the callee's success (i.e., forward returns/does not revert when the callee succeeds and reverts when the callee reverts) because it forwards the provided calldata; the mutant that calls callee.call("") (sending empty calldata) can change the callee outcome (e.g., succeed vs revert) for some calldata, causing forward's success/revert behaviour to differ.
change_summary: Make the call use a gas stipend of 0 by using low-level call with an empty gas specification via call(""), causing different success/failure behavior for callee that relies on gas (note: Solidity syntax unchanged except using call with empty payload to still compile).
